element_fields.description_en:
The ProductKey list of the products to which the devices belong.  
ProductKey is a globally unique identifier issued by the IoT Platform for a newly created product. You can view information about all products under your account in the IoT Platform console or by calling [QueryProductList](~~69271~~).  
><notice>For each device, you must specify both **ProductKey** and **DeviceName**, and the number of devices cannot exceed 20.  
></notice>
element_fields.description_zh:
要查询设备所属产品的ProductKey列表。
ProductKey是物联网平台为新建产品颁发的全局唯一标识符。您可以在物联网平台控制台或调用[QueryProductList](~~69271~~)，查看当前账号下所有产品的信息。
><notice>每个设备的 **ProductKey**与**DeviceName**必须同时传入，且设备个数不能超过20个。
></notice>

parameters.description_en:
Instance ID.<props="china"><ph>You can view the current instance **ID** on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console.</ph></props>  

><notice>  
- If an ID exists, you must specify it; otherwise, the invocation fails.  
- If no ID exists, you do not need to specify it.  

></notice>  

<props="china">For more information about instances, see [How to Obtain an Instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>
